org.jlab.coda.emu.modules

Class StreamAggregatorOrig.TimeSliceSorter

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Thread
      • org.jlab.coda.emu.modules.StreamAggregatorOrig.TimeSliceSorter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Runnable
    Enclosing class:
    StreamAggregatorOrig

    class StreamAggregatorOrig.TimeSliceSorter
extends java.lang.Thread
    The leading consumer of each input channel ring is the sorter thread. This thread sends all events of the same time frame to the ring of the same build thread. Each build thread consumes ring items that the sorter thread fills.
